messages.subject: Information Matrix

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Information Matrix
parts:
you can get the Hessian at the mode for the hyperparamters, like...

> r = inla(y ~ f(idx), data = data.frame(y=1:10, idx= 1:10))
> r$misc$cov.intern
[,1] [,2]
[1,] 7.472191657e-01 -1.444290654e-06
[2,] -1.444290654e-06 1.905098047e-01
> r$misc$cor.intern
[,1] [,2]
[1,] 1.000000000e+00 -3.828000039e-06
[2,] -3.828000039e-06 1.000000000e+00
